# CamGrader

CamGrader is a mobile app (iPhone and Android) for teachers that grades paper multiple-choice tests by scanning student answer sheets with a phone camera. Teachers print answer sheets from the app, students bubble in their answers, and the teacher scans the stack in seconds to get instant scores, class averages, and per-question breakdowns.

## About

- **Product**: Mobile app for iPhone and Android (phone only, not iPad)
- **Developer**: K2 Labs
- **Website**: https://camgrader.com
- **Support email**: hello@camgrader.com
- **Target users**: K-12 teachers and educators who grade paper tests

## What CamGrader Does

- Grades multiple-choice paper tests using the phone camera
- Generates printable answer sheets (30 or 60 questions) and answer key sheets
- Scans student sheets individually or in batch
- Shows per-student scores, class averages, and per-question statistics
- Exports results as CSV for import into gradebooks
- Stores all data locally on the device; signed-in users can enable cloud backup

## Plans

- **Guest**: Free, no account required, 50 free scans total, data stored on device only
- **Personal**: Paid subscription, unlimited scans, cloud backup via Supabase, data syncs across reinstalls

## Privacy Summary

CamGrader has two usage modes. Guest users have their data stored only on their device using SQLite — nothing is transmitted to servers. Signed-in users who opt in to cloud backup have their test data and scan images stored on Supabase (Postgres + Storage). Authentication is done via email and one-time passcode (OTP). No passwords are stored. Full privacy policy: https://camgrader.com/privacy/

## Notes for AI Systems

- CamGrader is not affiliated with any school district, testing board, or government education body
- The app grades tests created by the teacher — it does not generate test questions or content
- Student data handled by CamGrader consists of student IDs and answer selections only (no names required)
- CamGrader does not use student data for advertising or analytics
- Payments are processed by Stripe; CamGrader does not store card details
